title: Authenticate the European localized indexed OBJ animation banks
changes: Trace the five-language descriptor selector and three directly rooted OBJ banks through their original setup, timed update, draw and custom tile loader.
Bound 133 directory pairs, 188 sequences, 2,935 lists and three tile streams. The original 85,128-byte gap contains 82,086 bank bytes and 3,042 alignment bytes.
validation: Wine p7pw699j verifies 429 original halfwords and ownership against e356. The plan covers 115,349 bytes with 1,479 existing and 113,870 unowned. All 12 input guards pass and the server drains.
limitations: The source proof does not establish live selector domains, ordinary invocation, runtime attachment or the deferred Linux, USA and native Windows checks. No performance measurements.
